upstream.scope: srtop's displayed state follows the runtime's continuity decisions (RESUME_OK within retention, RESYNC_REQUIRED{SAME_SESSION} outside it, RESYNC_REQUIRED{REPLACED} after a real restart) with no reconnect logic of its own; a detached window is labelled stale by client chrome (PX-022-G01), keeps its cached data readable, and takes no new action or selection; same-session continuity keeps process identities and server-side explorer state; replacement abandons pending intent and inherits no selection, tag or last-observed record; T29 text handling unchanged and verified; the generic client and bridge fixes it relies on (stale-window selection freeze, bridge exit on daemon close) are PX-022-G02's, and the window status is PX-022-G01's; no shared source change here

entries.feature: srtop --journal-capacity N configures the one session's §18.1 retention window through srui_sessiond::Session::mint_with_config (default the runtime's; 0, a negative, non-numeric, empty, missing or repeated value is refused before any socket is published); every start mints a new incarnation and restores nothing, so a client resuming an earlier instance is answered REPLACED; srtop makes no continuity decision itself

Same-session continuity preserves the explorer: RESUME_OK replays exactly the missed commits, contiguous and without a snapshot, and RESYNC_REQUIRED{SAME_SESSION} carries this client's event frontier and a snapshot; through both, every row keeps its item identity and the selected process, the inspector target and tags are the same, over the fake sequence and over a live Linux /proc table (srtop's own process)

Replacement after a real srtop restart: RESYNC_REQUIRED{REPLACED} under a new token with frontier 0; the client closes the old incarnation's window and builds a new one from the new snapshot; no selection, no live or historical tag and no last-observed record of the old incarnation survives, and a text edit typed while detached is abandoned

A detached or catching-up srtop window over real SSH: the client-owned subtitle and accessibility help name the stale revision in every non-live state (disconnected, connecting, resynchronizing, session replaced) and clear only at ready, after the catch-up is applied; the server-owned title is untouched; while detached the cached rows, inspector and freshness line stay as they were (nothing is shown as newly sampled), a tag or pause press is not sent and is never replayed, and an arrow key cannot change the selection; only the newer of two overlapping attempts reaches the window

entries.feature: Pending text edits follow D1 §18.3 / D2 T29 in srtop: an edit typed while detached stays in its field locally, is replayed by RESUME_OK (the PID set filters on the server), and is discarded by a same-session snapshot resync and by a replacement, the field then showing the authoritative value
